Alex/Naomi — technical notes to inform sizing and the SOW:

- Latency: for 2k token sequences our hosted tail-p99 with batching is ~220–280ms on us-east for our mid-tier models; Dedicated (pinned GPU pool) typically yields 140–180ms p99. Network + roundtrip add ~20–30ms depending on client location.
- Capacity: 60 qps peak for PoC is fine on Hosted — we’ll use continuous batching plus KV caching. For production (70–150 qps sustained) recommend Dedicated with 1.5x capacity buffer (we can reserve N GPUs; details in attached estimate).
- Autoscaling/burst: Dedicated can be configured with burst into hosted capacity for unexpected spikes; cost profile: Dedicated base + hosted burst adds ~15–25% marginal cost vs Dedicated-only design.
- Security/compliance: we will include a regional-binding clause and provide SOC2 Type II, audit logs (redacted), and KMS integration notes. Private/on-prem remains an option but will add ~8–12 weeks for delivery and integration testing.

I attached a high-level cost_estimate CSV for HLX-3421. Naomi — if you want, I can convert to a short table for procurement (line items: PoC hosted hours, reserved GPUs, burst-usage allowance, SRE runbook).

-Karthik
